failures.message: Two files outside T1's list are required, and two more probably are. (1) core/src/main/scala/kafka/log/LogManager.scala is the real LogManager (dir selection, preferredLogDirs, metrics). The listed storage LogManager.java is only a static helper with no instance state, so cordon state, metrics and the 'never place in a cordoned dir' rule (ACC8, ACC10) cannot live there. (2) server/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/server/config/DynamicBrokerConfig.java defines ALL_DYNAMIC_CONFIGS and PER_BROKER_CONFIGS. DynamicConfig.Broker builds its dynamic set only from ALL_DYNAMIC_CONFIGS, so without an entry there cordoned.log.dirs cannot be set dynamically or per-broker (ACC1-3, ACC11). (3) Likely needed: the controller-side config validator, for the MV gate (ACC2) and log.dirs membership check (ACC1); I could not confirm its path or class name. (4) Possibly needed: core/src/main/scala/kafka/server/KafkaApis.scala for DescribeLogDirs wiring (ACC9); I have not checked.

advisories.text: When every live directory is cordoned, nextLogDirs falls back to a cordoned directory, so ACC30 ('never picks a cordoned directory') only holds while an uncordoned live directory exists. The integration test asserts the fallback, so it is deliberate, but it deserves a comment or a KIP check.

No test checks that heartbeats omit CordonedLogDirs before the initial catch-up and include them afterwards. A BrokerLifecycleManager unit test, a KafkaConfig validation unit test for cordoned.log.dirs, and a LogManager unit test for nextLogDirs are also missing; only the integration tests exercise them.
DynamicCordonedLogDirs has an empty validateReconfiguration, and BrokerRegistration.sorted() duplicates the sorting done in the constructor and in handleCordonedDirectories. Both could be trimmed.
